summary: Rachel Bovard is a conservative policy strategist. She was legislative director to Sen. Rand Paul and executive director of the Senate Steering Committee, and is now vice president of programs at the Conservative Partnership Institute (earlier its senior director of policy). A board member of the Edmund Burke Foundation and a regular NatCon speaker, she gave a main-stage address at NatCon 4 and in 2025 warned about "Silicon Valley disrupters" in the movement.
